reporting_note: The Canada Energy Regulator publishes pipeline incidents; refinery, generation and distribution outages are reported by operators and press, and provincial outage feeds are live-only.

sectors.reason: CER publishes about 1.93 million b/d across 17 refineries (2024). Upgraders must be excluded or the total is overstated by about 80%. Not scored. The recovery and decay model behind the Monitored-Area ESDI was calibrated on repeated strikes with almost no restart reporting, and no model for this country's events has been approved (GLOBAL_METHODOLOGY.md §2 and §8.3).

Statistics Canada publishes installed capacity by province and year, but there is no current open plant list. Not scored. The recovery and decay model behind the Monitored-Area ESDI was calibrated on repeated strikes with almost no restart reporting, and no model for this country's events has been approved (GLOBAL_METHODOLOGY.md §2 and §8.3).
No national register, and the event-burden measure does not fit weather outages. Event tracking only.
Pipeline capacity is published; there is no open terminal capacity census.
Processing incomplete; pipelines experimental; LNG export (one terminal) is context only.
Coal power is published within generation by province and year.
